title: Trakt Scrobble Progress Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trakt:scrobble progress_pct=*
| stats sum(progress_pct) as total_value, avg(progress_pct) as avg_value by title
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks title values by total and average progress percent across Trakt scrobble events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `progress_pct` values for each Trakt scrobble event and review total and average progress percent by title.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total progress percent.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep which title shows the biggest progress percent numbers in your Trakt scrobble data.
